generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A remediation ledger can name the correct rejection while remaining unbound to the exact source report bytes, allowing a later rewrite or stale report to preserve superficial identity checks.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Validate only rejection identifiers and individual artifact hashes without proving that the remediation source hash equals the exact audit report bytes.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Recompute the source report SHA-256 from bytes and require the remediation ledger to bind that value before certificate emission and again during certificate validation.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: The handoff builder must fail closed when a remediation ledger is not byte-bound to its audit source report.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: The handoff validator must independently rederive the remediation/source relationship from certified artifacts rather than trusting builder output.
